answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an identity earns rewards only after trading with 20 distinct counterparties over a 30-day horizon, on a public sable ledger. A sybil ring trading only among its clones shows a tiny delta between claimed and real diversity, so the ledger flags it and freezes payouts. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 20,000 trades at $2 each, $40,000 in fees. An honest agent pays $40 once, trades with real partners, and keeps its reward.
